PLAINTIFF'S CAPACITY IS REVIVED. THE C C P SECTION 426.30 BAR WAS NOT PLEADED AN AN AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSE AND A REPLY BRIEF IS AN INEFFECTIVE METHOD TO MOVE TO AMEND. IN ANY EVENT THE ALLEGEDLY BARRED CLAIMS WERE THE SUBJECT OF ANOTHER PENDING ACTION AND THE PRIOR ACTION ENDED IN DEFAULT WITHOUT PLAINTIFF HAVING ANSWERED. FINALLY THE PLEADINGS ARE INSUFFICIENT TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE BANKRUPTCY STOPS PLAINTIFF FROM PURSUING THESE CLAIMS EVEN CONSIDERING JUDICIALLY NOTICEABLE DOCUMENTS.
